/bin/bash -c "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
for folder in sorted(Path('.').glob('*/task.md')):
    case=folder.parent
    observer=json.loads((case/'observer.json').read_text())
    path=case/'after/browser-record.jsonl'
    record=path.read_bytes()
    lines=[json.loads(line) for line in record.splitlines()]
    print(f'\\n{case} RECORD sha256={hashlib.sha256(record).hexdigest()==observer[\"browser_record_sha256\"]}')
    snapshots=[i for i,event in enumerate(lines,1) if event.get('args',[''])[0]=='snapshot']
    for i,e in enumerate(lines,1):
        cmd=e.get('args')
        if cmd is None:
            print(i,e)
            continue
        print(i,e['exit'],' '.join(cmd), '' if 'output' in e else f'output_bytes={e[\"output_bytes\"]}')
        if i in snapshots:
            for l in e['output'].splitlines():
                if any(term in l for term in ('textbox','switch','radio \"Daily\"','radio \"Weekly\"','dialog','button \"Cancel\"','Confirm','Applying','Settings applied','Email:','Saved for',' - status','StaticText \"desk-news','StaticText \"digest-office','StaticText \"On\"','StaticText \"Daily\"','StaticText \"Weekly\"')):
                    print('  ',l.strip())
    before,after=case/'before',case/'after'
    check=lambda f:{p.relative_to(f).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest() for p in f.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    b,a=check(before),check(after)
    print('files before/after modification:', [p for p in b.keys() & a.keys() if b[p]"'!=a[p]], '"'added:',sorted(a.keys()-b.keys()),'removed:',sorted(b.keys()-a.keys()))
    digest_mismatches=[i for i,e in enumerate(lines,1) if 'output' in e and hashlib.sha256(e['output'].encode()).hexdigest()"'!=e['"'output_sha256']]
    print('stdout digest mismatches:',digest_mismatches)
    subset=[e for e in lines if 'output' in e or e['kind']"'!='"'browser']
    verification=[]
    for ob,e in zip(observer['actual_events'],subset):
        if e['kind']"'!='"'browser':
            verification.append(ob==e)
        else:
            verification.append(ob['args']==e['args'] and ob['runtime_exit']==e['exit'] and ob['stdout_sha256']==e['output_sha256'] and all(l in e['output'].splitlines() for l in ob['observed_lines']))
    print('observer agrees with raw:',all(verification),len(subset),len(observer['actual_events']))
PY"
